field_text_formatted.value: Publish-only mode and workspaces suit each other. Inside a workspace every save is a draft, including an edit to a page that's already live, so editors save freely and the workspace's publish is where the rules apply, in advise mode as well as block. drush vale:lint --workspace=stage runs the same check from a deploy script.
